human_readable_bug: DISTINCT selecting one input column under several result aliases generates duplicate pre-aggregate definitions, and the ID-based importer rejects the query before physical planning.
scope: Separate follow-up F01. This is the producer/import binding failure, not C23 bare-Null hash-key conversion.

source_contracts.claim: Reuses only an identical direct row-member read
source_contracts.evidence: The incoming Member must read its own lambda row argument. An existing definition must have identical full output spelling, forceOptional=false, a direct Member of its own row argument, and the same member name.

source_contracts.claim: Scope equality follows the shared pre-aggregate input
source_contracts.evidence: ProcessAggregationsInResultItems collects all definitions for one set-item input, then BuildAggregationPipeline builds the single pre-aggregate Map. Distinct lambda-argument node identities do not denote different source rows.

source_contracts.claim: Preserves visible aliases and DISTINCT tuple layout
source_contracts.evidence: BuildAggregationTraits and the appended result traits/key references below the changed branch remain unchanged. One shared input IU may feed multiple fresh aggregate result IUs; existing physical finish emits each explicit result mapping.

source_contracts.claim: Does not merge computations, nested members, or optional-forcing definitions
source_contracts.evidence: The guard rejects all such candidate matches. Genuine collisions remain available to the unchanged Duplicate Map output check instead of becoming silent overwrites.

source_contracts.claim: No evaluation multiplicity change for observable expressions
source_contracts.evidence: Only direct reads of the same already-produced row field are shared; the patch does not deduplicate its upstream expression or arbitrary calls.

TCoLambda, Maybe<TCoMember>, Struct/Args/Name Value access, tuple structured binding, and std::any_of are already supported and used in this translation unit. The vector element type matches the three destructured fields.

source_contracts.claim: Main-relative alias lowering does not require the C23 physical patch for admitted controls
source_contracts.evidence: Pinned main already deduplicates physical GetKeyFields by IU and emits DISTINCT finish fields using each trait mapping. C23 changes bare-Null key encoding; F01 controls use required/optional data values instead.

source_contracts.claim: Empty input remains empty under DISTINCT
source_contracts.evidence: The number of distinct result aliases and group-key references is not removed. Reusing a source definition does not turn keyed DISTINCT into scalar aggregation.

quality_observation: The small guard scans existing pre-aggregate definitions for each direct DISTINCT member; many aliases can incur quadratic rewrite-time comparisons. This is a separate optimization observation, not a correctness blocker for the narrow fix.
